name: Kurihara Sayaka
source:
"Oho~! Using your authority as the head of the family already, are we~?"

A servant of the Kuraki family.
Cheerful, outspoken, and friendly, she’s a mood-maker who interacts with Koichi in a casual, easygoing manner. It’s said that her appearance closely resembles that of a once-famous actress who mysteriously disappeared—but...
